Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent 2D game VFX sprite atlas for a Molotov explosion and burning fuel on a road.
Draw a production-quality realistic FIRE EFFECT ATLAS with exactly FOUR equally sized columns and TWO equally sized rows (4x2 = 8 frames). Landscape canvas 2:1 aspect ratio. All frames have transparent backgrounds, no grid lines, no panels, no labels, no text. Every frame stays inside its own cell with empty transparent padding on all four sides. Frame centers align identically. No objects, no bottles, no characters, no scenery.
Top row, left to right: four sequential phases of a compact gasoline/Molotov combustion burst viewed slightly from above/front in a side-scrolling action game: (1) brilliant white-yellow ignition and short orange lateral burst; (2) wide billowing orange/yellow fireball pushing outward with curling flames and a little dark gray smoke; (3) flames reaching outward and upward with more soft translucent smoke; (4) cooling smaller orange flames and dissolving smoke. A fuel flash, not a mushroom cloud or nuclear bomb. Detailed wispy turbulent tongues, glowing hot cores, volumetric gas, natural irregular edges, NOT a red circle, NOT cartoon symbols. Similar full footprint width in each frame, changes happen within it.
Bottom row: four consecutive looping animation frames of the SAME broad low patch of liquid fuel burning on a flat road, viewed at the SAME slight elevated angle. Ground footprint is a shallow horizontal oval, about twice as wide as high; low connected orange yellow fire licking upwards irregularly, rolling soft fire layers, several taller thin twisting flame wisps, white-yellow hot bases, subtle dark smoke drifting upwards. Connected continuous fuel-bed fire, not separate candle flames, not identical repeated teardrops. Each frame varies turbulence and flame shapes while keeping footprint, size and position constant for a seamless loop.
Style: realistic cinematic game VFX rendered with fine detail, natural transparent feathered glow and soot smoke, convincing fire physics, restrained orange/yellow/white, no outlines, no hard borders, no gray solid background, no blue flames, no graphic icons. Keep visual density light enough to see enemies through the translucent parts. Exactly 4 columns x 2 rows. Entire atlas RGBA transparency required.
